notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are the tnlandforms list (coordinates, county, BLL and gfc numbers) and one 2017 Commons photo. Nothing read gives a build date, staffing, fire history or current status, so status should stay unknown until someone checks. The Commons file's geodata (30.707684, -83.028515, in page metadata, not visible text, so not quoted) sits about 100 m from the list point, which supports the photo being at this site. Brief registers read 'BLL US 65193' and 'GFC US 829'; the list writes BLL-65193 and gfc-829, so the 'US' is not in the source. Not named in the cached NHLR Georgia list (29 lookouts) and the Statenville Wikipedia article has no tower mention.
